```{python}
#| label: initialise-report
#| echo: false
# Load findings.csv once; every table and figure below is computed from it
import sys
from pathlib import Path
from IPython.display import display, Markdown

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path("scripts")))
from analysis_findings import *

df = load_findings(CSV_PATH)
reviews = review_table(df)       # One row per review
found = findings_only(df)        # One row per finding
pairs = paired_table(reviews)    # Matched pairs of the first two report conditions
```
